name: neoblocker
description: Blocks toxic, hateful and rage-bait YouTube content with on-device AI. Private, local and fast.
author: Neoblocker

scripts.dev: npm run copy-wasm:dev && npm run copy-model:dev && plasmo dev
scripts.build:chrome: plasmo build --target=chrome-mv3 && npm run copy-wasm:chrome && npm run copy-model:chrome
scripts.build:firefox: plasmo build --target=firefox-mv3 && npm run copy-wasm:firefox && npm run copy-model:firefox
scripts.copy-wasm:dev: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-dev/wasm && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm build/chrome-mv3-dev/wasm/ && echo [copy-wasm:dev] done.
scripts.copy-wasm:chrome: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-prod/wasm && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm build/chrome-mv3-prod/wasm/ && echo [copy-wasm:chrome] done.
scripts.copy-wasm:firefox: mkdir -p build/firefox-mv3-prod/wasm && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm build/firefox-mv3-prod/wasm/ && echo [copy-wasm:firefox] done.
scripts.copy-model:dev: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-dev/models && cp -R assets/models/. build/chrome-mv3-dev/models/ && echo [copy-model:dev] done.
scripts.copy-model:chrome: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-prod/models && cp -R assets/models/. build/chrome-mv3-prod/models/ && echo [copy-model:chrome] done.
scripts.copy-model:firefox: mkdir -p build/firefox-mv3-prod/models && cp -R assets/models/. build/firefox-mv3-prod/models/ && echo [copy-model:firefox] done.

manifest.name: Neoblocker — Local AI YouTube Filter
manifest.description: Blocks toxic, hateful and rage-bait YouTube content with on-device AI. Private, local and fast.
